prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Write package solution in solution.go with the function at package scope.
Required API: func RingBufferTrace(capacity int, values []int) ([]int, bool)
Behavior: Simulate a fixed-capacity FIFO ring. Each value is pushed; emit the evicted oldest value, or -1 when no eviction occurs. Reject non-positive capacity and input value -1, which is reserved as the sentinel. Do not mutate input; empty input succeeds.
Visible example: capacity 2 with values [4,7,9,1] returns [-1,-1,4,7].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code:
package solution
func RingBufferTrace(capacity int, values []int)([]int,bool){if capacity<=0{return nil,false};out:=make([]int,len(values));q:=[]int{};for i,v:=range values{if v==-1{return nil,false};out[i]=-1;if len(q)==capacity{out[i]=q[0];q=q[1:]};q=append(q,v)};return out,true}
